ko.title: 30만 톤, 90일: 중간선거 전 소 다진육 관세 유예의 내막

segments.src: ## A Temporary Truce at the Grocery Counter
segments.tr: ## 식료품점 계산대에서의 임시 휴전

segments.src: Ground beef prices have been one of the more visible pain points at U.S.
segments.tr: 간고기 가격은 올해 미국

segments.src: supermarkets this year, and the Trump administration has responded with a narrowly targeted, time-limited move: a temporary reduction in tariffs on imported ground beef, reportedly capped around 300,000 tons and set to last roughly 90 days.
segments.tr: 슈퍼마켓에서 가장 눈에 띄는 고통 지점 중 하나였으며, 트럼프 행정부는 매우 구체적이고 기한이 정해진 조치로 대응했습니다: 수입 간고기에 대한 관세의 임시 인하로, 약 300,000톤으로 제한되며 약 90일간 지속될 예정입니다.

segments.src: The stated goal is straightforward — take some of the edge off beef prices before the November midterm elections, when grocery costs remain one of the most closely watched indicators of how voters feel about the economy.
segments.tr: 명시된 목표는 간단합니다 — 11월 중간선거 전에 간고기 가격의 압박을 어느 정도 완화하는 것입니다. 이때 식료품 비용은 유권자가 경제를 어떻게 생각하는지를 보여주는 가장 밀접하게 관찰되는 지표 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: Unlike a permanent policy shift, this kind of short-window tariff relief is designed to be reversible.
segments.tr: 영구적인 정책 변화와 달리, 이러한 단기 관세 완화는 되돌릴 수 있도록 설계되었습니다.

segments.src: It allows more imported ground beef to enter the country at a lower duty rate for a defined period, with the expectation that officials will reassess once the window closes.
segments.tr: 이는 정의된 기간 동안 수입 간고기가 더 낮은 세율로 국가에 진입할 수 있게 하며, 기한이 끝나면 관료들이 재평가할 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: Administration officials have framed the move as a pragmatic, consumer-focused step rather than a broader retreat from the tariff strategy applied to other goods.
segments.tr: 행정부 관료들은 이 조치를 다른 상품에 적용되는 관세 전략에서의 광범위한 후퇴보다는 실용적이고 소비자 중심의 조치로 표현했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Beef Got Expensive in the First Place
segments.tr: ## 간고기가 처음부터 비싼 이유

segments.src: The run-up in beef prices did not start with tariffs — it started on the range.
segments.tr: 간고기 가격 상승은 관세에서 시작되지 않았습니다 — 목장에서 시작되었습니다.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: cattle herd has been shrinking for years, a trend accelerated by prolonged drought conditions across major ranching states that made it more expensive to keep herds fed and watered.
segments.tr: 소 떼는 수년간 축소되어 왔으며, 이 추세는 주요 목축 주들의 지속된 가뭄 상황으로 인해 가속화되었는데, 이는 떼를 먹이고 물을 공급하는 비용을 더 비싸게 만들었습니다.

segments.src: Ranchers responded rationally by sending more cattle to slaughter and holding back fewer breeding animals, which cut supply in the short term but set up an even tighter herd for the years ahead.
segments.tr: 목축업자들은 더 많은 소를 도살장으로 보내고 번식용 소를 더 적게 남김으로써 합리적으로 대응했으며, 이는 단기적으로 공급을 줄였지만 향후 몇 년 동안 더욱 팽팽한 떼를 만들었습니다.

segments.src: That dynamic left the U.S.
segments.tr: 그 역학 관계는 미국

segments.src: beef supply chain unusually reliant on imports to meet domestic demand, particularly for the lean beef typically blended into ground beef products.
segments.tr: 간고기 공급망이 국내 수요를 충족하기 위해 수입에 이례적으로 의존하게 했으며, 특히 간고기 제품에 일반적으로 혼합되는 저지방 간고기의 경우 더욱 그러합니다.

segments.src: When tariffs on imported beef rose earlier in the broader trade policy push, that additional cost fed directly into retail prices at a moment when herd numbers were already near multi-decade lows.
segments.tr: 광범위한 무역 정책 추진 과정에서 수입 간고기에 대한 관세가 인상되었을 때, 그 추가 비용은 떼의 수가 이미 수십 년 만의 최저 수준에 가까워진 시점에 소매 가격에 직접 반영되었습니다.

segments.src: ## The Case for the Break
segments.tr: ## 휴전의 명분

segments.src: Supporters of the temporary tariff reduction argue it is a targeted, limited-duration fix aimed at a specific product category rather than a wholesale change in trade policy.
segments.tr: 임시 관세 인하 지지자들은 이것이 무역 정책의 대규모 변화보다는 특정 제품 범주를 목표로 한 구체적이고 기한이 정해진 해결책이라고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Ground beef is a kitchen-table staple, and price relief there can have an outsized effect on how households perceive overall inflation, even if it does not move the needle much on headline economic statistics.
segments.tr: 소 다진육은 가정의 필수 식재료이며, 여기서의 가격 완화는 헤드라인 경제 통계에는 크게 영향을 주지 못하더라도 가계가 전체 인플레이션을 인식하는 방식에 과도한 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, cost-of-living concerns — especially at the grocery store — have remained a top issue for voters across the political spectrum, and officials have signaled they want tangible, visible relief before Election Day.
segments.tr: 중간선거가 다가오면서 생활비 우려—특히 식료품점에서의—가 정치 스펙트럼 전체의 유권자들에게 주요 이슈로 남아 있으며, 정책 담당자들은 선거일 전에 실질적이고 눈에 띄는 완화를 원한다고 신호를 보냈습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Ranching-State Republicans Are Uneasy
segments.tr: ## 목축주 주 공화당원들이 불안한 이유

segments.src: Not everyone in the president's own party is on board.
segments.tr: 대통령의 정당 내 모두가 동의하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Lawmakers from cattle-heavy states have spent recent years pushing policies meant to help ranchers rebuild the domestic herd — from disaster assistance tied to drought losses to trade measures intended to support demand for U.S.-raised beef.
segments.tr: 소 사육이 집중된 주의 의원들은 최근 몇 년간 목장주들이 국내 축군을 다시 키우도록 돕기 위한 정책을 추진해왔습니다—가뭄 손실과 연계된 재해 지원에서 미국산 소고기 수요 지원을 목표로 하는 무역 조치까지.

segments.src: Their concern with a tariff break, even a temporary one, is that it sends a mixed signal at a delicate moment: just as herd rebuilding becomes more attractive because prices are finally high enough to justify expansion, cheaper imports could blunt the price incentive that ranchers need to hold back heifers and grow their herds again.
segments.tr: 일시적이더라도 관세 유예에 대한 우려는 민감한 시점에서 혼합된 신호를 보낸다는 것입니다: 가격이 마침내 확장을 정당화할 만큼 높아지면서 축군 재건이 더욱 매력적이 되는 바로 그 시점에, 더 싼 수입품은 목장주들이 암소를 보유하고 축군을 다시 키우는 데 필요한 가격 인센티브를 약화시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: That tension reflects a broader, familiar trade-off in agricultural trade policy: measures that help consumers in the short term can work against producers trying to make long-term investment decisions, and cattle ranching in particular involves multi-year breeding cycles that don't respond well to short bursts of price volatility.
segments.tr: 그 긴장은 농업 무역 정책의 더 광범위하고 친숙한 트레이드오프를 반영합니다: 단기적으로 소비자를 돕는 조치는 장기 투자 결정을 시도하는 생산자들에게 역효과를 낼 수 있으며, 특히 소 목축은 가격 변동성의 단기 변동에 잘 대응하지 못하는 다년간 번식 순환을 포함합니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 다음에 주시할 것

segments.src: A few things will determine whether this ends up as a minor, forgettable adjustment or a more consequential shift:
segments.tr: 몇 가지가 이것이 사소한 조정인지 아니면 더 중대한 변화인지를 결정할 것입니다:

segments.src: - **Where the imported beef comes from.** The countries granted expanded access matter both for supply chain logistics and for how the move fits into the administration's broader trade posture with those trading partners.
segments.tr: - **수입 소고기가 어디서 오는가.** 확대 접근권이 부여된 국가들은 공급망 물류와 이 조치가 그 거래 상대국과의 행정부의 더 광범위한 무역 입장에 어떻게 부합하는지 모두에 중요합니다.

segments.src: - **What happens at the 90-day mark.** Whether the tariff break is allowed to expire, extended, or made permanent will signal how the administration is weighing consumer prices against domestic ranching interests going forward.
segments.tr: - **90일 시점에서 무엇이 일어나는가.** 관세 유예가 만료, 연장, 또는 영구화되도록 허용되는지 여부는 행정부가 앞으로 소비자 가격을 국내 목축 이익과 어떻게 비교하고 있는지 신호를 보낼 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Herd rebuilding trends.** Government data on cattle inventories, released periodically by the U.S. Department of Agriculture, will show whether ranchers are still moving toward herd expansion despite the added import competition.
segments.tr: - **축군 재건 추세.** 미국 농무부에서 주기적으로 발표하는 소 재고에 관한 정부 데이터는 목장주들이 추가된 수입 경쟁에도 불구하고 여전히 축군 확장을 향해 움직이고 있는지를 보여줄 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Retail price pass-through.** Tariff relief does not automatically translate into lower shelf prices; how much of the savings reaches consumers versus processors and retailers will shape the political payoff of the move.
segments.tr: - **소매 가격 전가.** 관세 완화는 자동으로 낮아진 선반 가격으로 변환되지 않습니다; 절감액 중 소비자 대 가공업체 및 소매업체에 도달하는 정도가 이 조치의 정치적 이익을 형성할 것입니다.

segments.src: For now, the policy sits in a familiar spot for election-year economics: a short-term fix aimed at an immediate, visible cost pressure, layered on top of a longer-running structural challenge in the cattle industry that a 90-day tariff window is unlikely to resolve on its own.
segments.tr: 당분간, 이 정책은 선거 연도 경제의 친숙한 자리에 앉아 있습니다: 즉각적이고 눈에 띄는 비용 압력을 목표로 한 단기 해결책으로, 90일 관세 창으로는 자체적으로 해결할 가능성이 낮은 소 산업의 더 오래 지속되는 구조적 과제 위에 계층화되어 있습니다.

zh.title: 30万吨、90天：中期选举前的进口碎牛肉关税豁免

segments.src: ## A Temporary Truce at the Grocery Counter
segments.tr: ## 杂货店的临时休战

segments.src: Ground beef prices have been one of the more visible pain points at U.S.
segments.tr: 碎牛肉价格一直是美国

segments.src: supermarkets this year, and the Trump administration has responded with a narrowly targeted, time-limited move: a temporary reduction in tariffs on imported ground beef, reportedly capped around 300,000 tons and set to last roughly 90 days.
segments.tr: 超市今年的突出问题之一，特朗普政府采取了有针对性且有时间限制的措施作为回应：临时降低进口碎牛肉的关税，据报道上限约为300,000吨，持续时间约为90天。

segments.src: The stated goal is straightforward — take some of the edge off beef prices before the November midterm elections, when grocery costs remain one of the most closely watched indicators of how voters feel about the economy.
segments.tr: 明确的目标很直白——在11月中期选举前缓解牛肉价格，届时食品杂货成本仍是衡量选民对经济态度的最受关注的指标之一。

segments.src: Unlike a permanent policy shift, this kind of short-window tariff relief is designed to be reversible.
segments.tr: 与永久性政策转变不同，这种短期关税豁免设计成可逆的。

segments.src: It allows more imported ground beef to enter the country at a lower duty rate for a defined period, with the expectation that officials will reassess once the window closes.
segments.tr: 它允许更多进口碎牛肉以更低的税率进入该国，期限有限，预期在窗口期结束后官员会重新评估。

segments.src: Administration officials have framed the move as a pragmatic, consumer-focused step rather than a broader retreat from the tariff strategy applied to other goods.
segments.tr: 政府官员将此举定性为务实、以消费者为中心的措施，而非对适用于其他商品的关税战略的更广泛退缩。

segments.src: ## Why Beef Got Expensive in the First Place
segments.tr: ## 牛肉为什么会涨价

segments.src: The run-up in beef prices did not start with tariffs — it started on the range.
segments.tr: 牛肉价格的上升不是从关税开始的——它始于牧场。

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: cattle herd has been shrinking for years, a trend accelerated by prolonged drought conditions across major ranching states that made it more expensive to keep herds fed and watered.
segments.tr: 的牲畜群体多年来一直在缩小，这一趋势因主要牧场州的长期干旱而加剧，干旱增加了维持牲畜饲料和水源的成本。

segments.src: Ranchers responded rationally by sending more cattle to slaughter and holding back fewer breeding animals, which cut supply in the short term but set up an even tighter herd for the years ahead.
segments.tr: 牧场主的理性反应是送更多牲畜屠宰，保留较少的繁殖动物，这在短期内削减了供应，但为未来几年的群体设置了更加紧张的局面。

segments.src: That dynamic left the U.S.
segments.tr: 这一动态使美国

segments.src: beef supply chain unusually reliant on imports to meet domestic demand, particularly for the lean beef typically blended into ground beef products.
segments.tr: 牛肉供应链对进口的依赖异常之大，以满足国内需求，特别是对通常混入碎牛肉产品中的瘦牛肉的依赖。

segments.src: When tariffs on imported beef rose earlier in the broader trade policy push, that additional cost fed directly into retail prices at a moment when herd numbers were already near multi-decade lows.
segments.tr: 当进口牛肉关税在更广泛的贸易政策推动中上升时，这一额外成本在牲畜数量已接近数十年来最低水平的时刻直接传导到零售价格。

segments.src: ## The Case for the Break
segments.tr: ## 支持这一豁免的理由

segments.src: Supporters of the temporary tariff reduction argue it is a targeted, limited-duration fix aimed at a specific product category rather than a wholesale change in trade policy.
segments.tr: 临时关税削减的支持者辩称，这是针对特定产品类别的精准、有限期的解决方案，而非贸易政策的大规模改变。

segments.src: Ground beef is a kitchen-table staple, and price relief there can have an outsized effect on how households perceive overall inflation, even if it does not move the needle much on headline economic statistics.
segments.tr: 碎牛肉是家庭日常食品，其价格缓解可能对家庭如何感知整体通胀产生巨大影响，即使它对主要经济统计数据的影响不大。

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, cost-of-living concerns — especially at the grocery store — have remained a top issue for voters across the political spectrum, and officials have signaled they want tangible, visible relief before Election Day.
segments.tr: 随着中期选举临近，生活成本问题——尤其是在杂货店的成本——对整个政治光谱的选民仍然是首要问题，官员们表示希望在选举日前提供切实、可见的救济。

segments.src: ## Why Ranching-State Republicans Are Uneasy
segments.tr: ## 牧场州共和党人为何不安

segments.src: Not everyone in the president's own party is on board.
segments.tr: 总统自己党内并非所有人都支持。

segments.src: Lawmakers from cattle-heavy states have spent recent years pushing policies meant to help ranchers rebuild the domestic herd — from disaster assistance tied to drought losses to trade measures intended to support demand for U.S.-raised beef.
segments.tr: 来自牧牛众多州的议员近年来一直在推动旨在帮助牧场主重建国内牲畜群体的政策——从与干旱损失相关的灾难援助到旨在支持美国本地牛肉需求的贸易措施。

segments.src: Their concern with a tariff break, even a temporary one, is that it sends a mixed signal at a delicate moment: just as herd rebuilding becomes more attractive because prices are finally high enough to justify expansion, cheaper imports could blunt the price incentive that ranchers need to hold back heifers and grow their herds again.
segments.tr: 他们对关税豁免（即使是临时的）的关切在于，在微妙时刻它发出了混合信号：正当牲畜群体重建变得更具吸引力，因为价格终于高到足以证明扩张是合理的时候，更便宜的进口可能会削弱牧场主保留小母牛进行繁殖和再次扩大群体所需的价格激励。

segments.src: That tension reflects a broader, familiar trade-off in agricultural trade policy: measures that help consumers in the short term can work against producers trying to make long-term investment decisions, and cattle ranching in particular involves multi-year breeding cycles that don't respond well to short bursts of price volatility.
segments.tr: 这一紧张关系反映了农业贸易政策中更广泛、熟悉的权衡：短期内帮助消费者的措施可能与试图做出长期投资决策的生产者相悖，特别是养牛业涉及多年繁殖周期，这些周期对短期价格波动反应不佳。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来需要关注的事项

segments.src: A few things will determine whether this ends up as a minor, forgettable adjustment or a more consequential shift:
segments.tr: 几个因素将决定这最终是成为一个次要的、容易被遗忘的调整，还是更有影响的转变：

segments.src: - **Where the imported beef comes from.** The countries granted expanded access matter both for supply chain logistics and for how the move fits into the administration's broader trade posture with those trading partners.
segments.tr: - **进口牛肉的来源地。** 获得扩大准入的国家对供应链物流和该举措如何融入政府与这些贸易伙伴的更广泛贸易立场都很重要。

segments.src: - **What happens at the 90-day mark.** Whether the tariff break is allowed to expire, extended, or made permanent will signal how the administration is weighing consumer prices against domestic ranching interests going forward.
segments.tr: - **90天后会发生什么。** 是否允许关税豁免到期、延期或永久化将表明政府今后如何权衡消费者价格与国内养牛业利益。

hi.title: 300,000 टन, 90 दिन: मध्यावधि चुनावों से पहले जमीन बीफ टैरिफ ब्रेक के अंदर

segments.src: ## A Temporary Truce at the Grocery Counter
segments.tr: ## किराने की काउंटर पर एक अस्थायी संधि

segments.src: Ground beef prices have been one of the more visible pain points at U.S.
segments.tr: जमीन बीफ की कीमतें अमेरिकी

segments.src: supermarkets this year, and the Trump administration has responded with a narrowly targeted, time-limited move: a temporary reduction in tariffs on imported ground beef, reportedly capped around 300,000 tons and set to last roughly 90 days.
segments.tr: सुपरमार्केट में इस साल के अधिक दृश्यमान दर्द के बिंदुओं में से एक रही है, और ट्रम्प प्रशासन ने एक संकीर्ण रूप से लक्षित, समय-सीमित कदम के साथ प्रतिक्रिया दी है: आयातित जमीन बीफ पर टैरिफ में अस्थायी कमी, कथित रूप से लगभग 300,000 टन तक सीमित और लगभग 90 दिनों तक चलने के लिए सेट।

segments.src: The stated goal is straightforward — take some of the edge off beef prices before the November midterm elections, when grocery costs remain one of the most closely watched indicators of how voters feel about the economy.
segments.tr: कथित लक्ष्य सीधा है — नवंबर के मध्यावधि चुनावों से पहले बीफ की कीमतों में कुछ कमी लाना, जब किराने की लागत मतदाताओं को अर्थव्यवस्था के प्रति कैसा महसूस कराती है इसके सबसे बारीकी से देखे जाने वाले संकेतकों में से एक बनी रहती है।

segments.src: Unlike a permanent policy shift, this kind of short-window tariff relief is designed to be reversible.
segments.tr: स्थायी नीति परिवर्तन के विपरीत, इस तरह की अल्पकालीन टैरिफ राहत को प्रतिवर्ती बनाने के लिए डिजाइन किया गया है।

segments.src: It allows more imported ground beef to enter the country at a lower duty rate for a defined period, with the expectation that officials will reassess once the window closes.
segments.tr: यह अधिक आयातित जमीन बीफ को एक निर्धारित अवधि के लिए कम ड्यूटी दर पर देश में प्रवेश करने की अनुमति देता है, इस उम्मीद के साथ कि अधिकारी विंडो बंद होने के बाद पुनर्मूल्यांकन करेंगे।

segments.src: Administration officials have framed the move as a pragmatic, consumer-focused step rather than a broader retreat from the tariff strategy applied to other goods.
segments.tr: प्रशासन के अधिकारियों ने इस कदम को एक व्यावहारिक, उपभोक्ता-केंद्रित कदम के रूप में प्रस्तुत किया है, बजाय अन्य सामानों पर लागू टैरिफ रणनीति से व्यापक पीछे हटने के।

segments.src: ## Why Beef Got Expensive in the First Place
segments.tr: ## बीफ पहली जगह में महंगा क्यों हुआ

segments.src: The run-up in beef prices did not start with tariffs — it started on the range.
segments.tr: बीफ की कीमतों में वृद्धि टैरिफ के साथ शुरू नहीं हुई — यह रेंज पर शुरू हुई।

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी

segments.src: cattle herd has been shrinking for years, a trend accelerated by prolonged drought conditions across major ranching states that made it more expensive to keep herds fed and watered.
segments.tr: मवेशी झुंड वर्षों से सिकुड़ रहा है, एक प्रवृत्ति जो प्रमुख पशु पालन राज्यों में लंबे समय तक सूखे की स्थिति से तेजी पाई है जिसने झुंडों को खिलाना और पानी देना अधिक महंगा बनाया है।

segments.src: Ranchers responded rationally by sending more cattle to slaughter and holding back fewer breeding animals, which cut supply in the short term but set up an even tighter herd for the years ahead.
segments.tr: पशु पालकों ने अधिक मवेशियों को कत्ल के लिए भेजकर और कम प्रजनन पशुओं को रोक कर समझदारी से प्रतिक्रिया दी, जिससे अल्पकाल में आपूर्ति में कटौती हुई, लेकिन आने वाले वर्षों के लिए एक और भी तंग झुंड स्थापित किया।

segments.src: That dynamic left the U.S.
segments.tr: उस गतिविधि ने अमेरिकी

segments.src: beef supply chain unusually reliant on imports to meet domestic demand, particularly for the lean beef typically blended into ground beef products.
segments.tr: बीफ आपूर्ति श्रृंखला को घरेलू मांग को पूरा करने के लिए असामान्य रूप से आयात पर निर्भर बनाया है, विशेष रूप से दुबले बीफ के लिए जो आमतौर पर जमीन बीफ उत्पादों में मिश्रित होता है।

segments.src: When tariffs on imported beef rose earlier in the broader trade policy push, that additional cost fed directly into retail prices at a moment when herd numbers were already near multi-decade lows.
segments.tr: जब व्यापक व्यापार नीति प्रयास में पहले आयातित बीफ पर टैरिफ बढ़ा, तो वह अतिरिक्त लागत सीधे खुदरा कीमतों में चली गई, ऐसे समय में जब झुंड संख्या पहले से ही बहु-दशक के निम्नतम स्तर के पास थी।

segments.src: ## The Case for the Break
segments.tr: ## ब्रेक के लिए मामला

segments.src: Supporters of the temporary tariff reduction argue it is a targeted, limited-duration fix aimed at a specific product category rather than a wholesale change in trade policy.
segments.tr: अस्थायी टैरिफ कमी के समर्थकों का तर्क है कि यह एक लक्षित, सीमित-अवधि की मरम्मत है जो व्यापार नीति में एक संपूर्ण बदलाव के बजाय एक विशिष्ट उत्पाद श्रेणी के लिए लक्षित है।

segments.src: Ground beef is a kitchen-table staple, and price relief there can have an outsized effect on how households perceive overall inflation, even if it does not move the needle much on headline economic statistics.
segments.tr: जमीन बीफ एक रसोई-मेज मुख्य वस्तु है, और वहां मूल्य राहत घरों को समग्र मुद्रास्फीति कैसे मानते हैं पर एक अतिरंजित प्रभाव डाल सकती है, भले ही यह हेडलाइन आर्थिक आंकड़ों पर सुई को बहुत अधिक हिलाए न।

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, cost-of-living concerns — especially at the grocery store — have remained a top issue for voters across the political spectrum, and officials have signaled they want tangible, visible relief before Election Day.
segments.tr: मध्यावधि के करीब आने के साथ, जीवन यापन की लागत की चिंताएं — विशेष रूप से किराने की दुकान में — राजनीतिक स्पेक्ट्रम में मतदाताओं के लिए शीर्ष मुद्दा बनी हुई हैं, और अधिकारियों ने संकेत दिया है कि वे चुनाव दिवस से पहले ठोस, दृश्यमान राहत चाहते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why Ranching-State Republicans Are Uneasy
segments.tr: ## पशु पालन-राज्य के गणराज्य सदस्य असहज क्यों हैं

segments.src: Not everyone in the president's own party is on board.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रपति की अपनी पार्टी के सभी सदस्य सहमत नहीं हैं।

segments.src: Lawmakers from cattle-heavy states have spent recent years pushing policies meant to help ranchers rebuild the domestic herd — from disaster assistance tied to drought losses to trade measures intended to support demand for U.S.-raised beef.
segments.tr: पशु-प्रधान राज्यों के विधायकों ने पशु पालकों को घरेलू झुंड को फिर से बनाने में मदद करने के लिए नीतियों को आगे बढ़ाने में हाल के वर्षों व्यतीत किए हैं — सूखे के नुकसान से जुड़ी आपदा सहायता से लेकर यू.एस.-पालित बीफ के लिए मांग का समर्थन करने के लिए व्यापार उपायों तक।

segments.src: Their concern with a tariff break, even a temporary one, is that it sends a mixed signal at a delicate moment: just as herd rebuilding becomes more attractive because prices are finally high enough to justify expansion, cheaper imports could blunt the price incentive that ranchers need to hold back heifers and grow their herds again.
segments.tr: टैरिफ ब्रेक के साथ उनकी चिंता, भले ही एक अस्थायी हो, यह है कि यह एक नाजुक क्षण में एक मिश्रित संकेत भेजता है: जैसे ही झुंड पुनर्निर्माण अधिक आकर्षक हो जाता है क्योंकि कीमतें विस्तार को औचित्य देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं, सस्ते आयात पशु पालकों को हीफर को पीछे रखने और अपने झुंड को फिर से विकसित करने की आवश्यकता वाली मूल्य प्रोत्साहन को कुंद कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: That tension reflects a broader, familiar trade-off in agricultural trade policy: measures that help consumers in the short term can work against producers trying to make long-term investment decisions, and cattle ranching in particular involves multi-year breeding cycles that don't respond well to short bursts of price volatility.
segments.tr: यह तनाव कृषि व्यापार नीति में एक व्यापक, परिचित व्यापार-बंद को दर्शाता है: ऐसे उपाय जो अल्पकाल में उपभोक्ताओं की मदद करते हैं, दीर्घकालीन निवेश निर्णय लेने का प्रयास करने वाले निर्माताओं के खिलाफ काम कर सकते हैं, और मवेशी पालन विशेष रूप से बहु-वर्षीय प्रजनन चक्र शामिल करते हैं जो कीमत की अस्थिरता के छोटे विस्फोटों का अच्छी तरह से जवाब नहीं देते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## अगला क्या देखना है

segments.src: A few things will determine whether this ends up as a minor, forgettable adjustment or a more consequential shift:
segments.tr: कुछ चीजें यह निर्धारित करेंगी कि क्या यह एक मामूली, भूलने योग्य समायोजन या अधिक परिणामी बदलाव के रूप में समाप्त होता है:

segments.src: - **Where the imported beef comes from.** The countries granted expanded access matter both for supply chain logistics and for how the move fits into the administration's broader trade posture with those trading partners.
segments.tr: - **आयातित बीफ कहां से आता है।** विस्तारित पहुंच दिए गए देश आपूर्ति श्रृंखला की लॉजिस्टिक्स और उन व्यापार भागीदारों के साथ प्रशासन की व्यापक व्यापार मुद्रा में इस कदम कैसे फिट करता है, दोनों के लिए मायने रखते हैं।

segments.src: - **What happens at the 90-day mark.** Whether the tariff break is allowed to expire, extended, or made permanent will signal how the administration is weighing consumer prices against domestic ranching interests going forward.
segments.tr: - **90-दिन के निशान पर क्या होता है।** क्या टैरिफ ब्रेक को समाप्त होने की अनुमति दी जाती है, विस्तारित किया जाता है, या स्थायी रूप से किया जाता है, यह संकेत देगा कि प्रशासन आगे बढ़ते हुए उपभोक्ता कीमतों को घरेलू पशु पालन हितों के विरुद्ध कैसे तौल रहा है।

segments.src: - **Herd rebuilding trends.** Government data on cattle inventories, released periodically by the U.S. Department of Agriculture, will show whether ranchers are still moving toward herd expansion despite the added import competition.
segments.tr: - **झुंड पुनर्निर्माण प्रवृत्ति।** मवेशी सूचियों पर सरकारी डेटा, यू.एस. कृषि विभाग द्वारा समय-समय पर जारी किया गया, दिखाएगा कि पशु पालकों को अतिरिक्त आयात प्रतिस्पर्धा के बावजूद झुंड विस्तार की ओर बढ़ रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **Retail price pass-through.** Tariff relief does not automatically translate into lower shelf prices; how much of the savings reaches consumers versus processors and retailers will shape the political payoff of the move.
segments.tr: - **खुदरा मूल्य पास-थ्रू।** टैरिफ राहत स्वचालित रूप से कम शेल्फ कीमतों में अनुवाद नहीं करती है; कितनी बचत उपभोक्ताओं तक पहुंचती है बनाम प्रोसेसर और खुदरा विक्रेताओं को इस कदम का राजनीतिक रिटर्न तय करेगा।

segments.src: For now, the policy sits in a familiar spot for election-year economics: a short-term fix aimed at an immediate, visible cost pressure, layered on top of a longer-running structural challenge in the cattle industry that a 90-day tariff window is unlikely to resolve on its own.
segments.tr: अभी के लिए, नीति चुनाव-वर्ष अर्थशास्त्र में एक परिचित स्थान बैठती है: एक तत्काल, दृश्यमान लागत दबाव के लिए लक्षित एक अल्पकालीन समाधान, मवेशी उद्योग में एक लंबे समय से चलने वाली संरचनात्मक चुनौती के शीर्ष पर स्तरित है जो 90-दिन की टैरिफ विंडो अपने आप को हल करने की संभावना नहीं है।

segments.src: Ground beef is a kitchen-table staple, and price relief there can have an outsized effect on how households perceive overall inflation, even if it does not move the needle much on headline economic statistics.
segments.tr: Le bœuf haché est un aliment de base du quotidien, et un allègement des prix peut avoir un effet démesurément grand sur la façon dont les ménages perçoivent l'inflation générale, même si cela n'a pas beaucoup d'impact sur les statistiques économiques générales.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, cost-of-living concerns — especially at the grocery store — have remained a top issue for voters across the political spectrum, and officials have signaled they want tangible, visible relief before Election Day.

segments.src: ## Why Ranching-State Republicans Are Uneasy
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les républicains des États d'élevage sont mal à l'aise

segments.src: Not everyone in the president's own party is on board.
segments.tr: Pas tout le monde au sein du parti du président n'est d'accord.

segments.src: Lawmakers from cattle-heavy states have spent recent years pushing policies meant to help ranchers rebuild the domestic herd — from disaster assistance tied to drought losses to trade measures intended to support demand for U.S.-raised beef.
segments.tr: Les législateurs des États riches en bétail ont passé les dernières années à promouvoir des politiques destinées à aider les éleveurs à reconstruire le troupeau domestique — de l'assistance en cas de sinistre liée aux pertes de sécheresse aux mesures commerciales destinées à soutenir la demande de bœuf élevé aux États-Unis.

segments.src: Their concern with a tariff break, even a temporary one, is that it sends a mixed signal at a delicate moment: just as herd rebuilding becomes more attractive because prices are finally high enough to justify expansion, cheaper imports could blunt the price incentive that ranchers need to hold back heifers and grow their herds again.
segments.tr: Leur préoccupation concernant une réduction tarifaire, même temporaire, est qu'elle envoie un signal mitigé à un moment délicat : juste au moment où la reconstruction du troupeau devient plus attrayante parce que les prix sont enfin assez élevés pour justifier l'expansion, les importations moins chères pourraient émousser l'incitation au prix dont les éleveurs ont besoin pour retenir les génisses et reconstituer leurs troupeaux.

segments.src: That tension reflects a broader, familiar trade-off in agricultural trade policy: measures that help consumers in the short term can work against producers trying to make long-term investment decisions, and cattle ranching in particular involves multi-year breeding cycles that don't respond well to short bursts of price volatility.
segments.tr: Cette tension reflète un compromis plus large et familier dans la politique commerciale agricole : les mesures qui aident les consommateurs à court terme peuvent travailler contre les producteurs qui essaient de prendre des décisions d'investissement à long terme, et l'élevage de bétail en particulier implique des cycles d'élevage de plusieurs années qui ne répondent pas bien aux courtes rafales de volatilité des prix.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: A few things will determine whether this ends up as a minor, forgettable adjustment or a more consequential shift:
segments.tr: Quelques choses détermineront si cela finit par être un ajustement mineur et oubliable ou un changement plus important :

segments.src: - **Where the imported beef comes from.** The countries granted expanded access matter both for supply chain logistics and for how the move fits into the administration's broader trade posture with those trading partners.
segments.tr: - **D'où provient le bœuf importé.** Les pays auxquels l'accès est élargi sont importants tant pour la logistique de la chaîne d'approvisionnement que pour la façon dont la mesure s'inscrit dans la posture commerciale plus large de l'administration vis-à-vis de ces partenaires commerciaux.

segments.src: - **What happens at the 90-day mark.** Whether the tariff break is allowed to expire, extended, or made permanent will signal how the administration is weighing consumer prices against domestic ranching interests going forward.

segments.src: - **Herd rebuilding trends.** Government data on cattle inventories, released periodically by the U.S. Department of Agriculture, will show whether ranchers are still moving toward herd expansion despite the added import competition.
segments.tr: - **Tendances de reconstruction du troupeau.** Les données gouvernementales sur les inventaires de bétail, publiées périodiquement par le U.S. Department of Agriculture, montreront si les éleveurs se dirigent toujours vers l'expansion des troupeaux malgré la concurrence supplémentaire à l'importation.

segments.src: - **Retail price pass-through.** Tariff relief does not automatically translate into lower shelf prices; how much of the savings reaches consumers versus processors and retailers will shape the political payoff of the move.
segments.tr: - **Transmission du prix de détail.** La réduction tarifaire ne se traduit pas automatiquement par une baisse des prix en rayon ; la part des économies qui atteint les consommateurs par rapport aux transformateurs et aux détaillants déterminera le bénéfice politique de la mesure.

segments.src: For now, the policy sits in a familiar spot for election-year economics: a short-term fix aimed at an immediate, visible cost pressure, layered on top of a longer-running structural challenge in the cattle industry that a 90-day tariff window is unlikely to resolve on its own.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, la politique se situe dans un endroit familier de la tactique économique électorale : une solution à court terme visant une pression de coût immédiate et visible, superposée sur un défi structural de plus longue date dans l'industrie du bétail qu'une fenêtre tarifaire de 90 jours est peu probable de résoudre par elle-même.

segments.src: ## Why Beef Got Expensive in the First Place

segments.src: ## The Case for the Break

segments.src: ## Why Ranching-State Republicans Are Uneasy

segments.src: Their concern with a tariff break, even a temporary one, is that it sends a mixed signal at a delicate moment: just as herd rebuilding becomes more attractive because prices are finally high enough to justify expansion, cheaper imports could blunt the price incentive that ranchers need to hold back heifers and grow their herds again.

segments.src: For now, the policy sits in a familiar spot for election-year economics: a short-term fix aimed at an immediate, visible cost pressure, layered on top of a longer-running structural challenge in the cattle industry that a 90-day tariff window is unlikely to resolve on its own.

segments.src: ## A Temporary Truce at the Grocery Counter
segments.tr: ## Một Thỏa Thuận Tạm Thời tại Quầy Tạp Hóa

segments.src: Ground beef prices have been one of the more visible pain points at U.S.
segments.tr: Giá thịt bò xay đã là một trong những điểm nhức nhối rõ rệt nhất tại các siêu thị U.S.

segments.src: supermarkets this year, and the Trump administration has responded with a narrowly targeted, time-limited move: a temporary reduction in tariffs on imported ground beef, reportedly capped around 300,000 tons and set to last roughly 90 days.
segments.tr: năm nay, và chính quyền Trump đã phản ứng bằng một bước đi hẹp hướng tới mục tiêu, có giới hạn thời gian: giảm thuế tạm thời đối với thịt bò xay nhập khẩu, được cho là giới hạn khoảng 300,000 tấn và dự kiến kéo dài khoảng 90 ngày.

segments.src: The stated goal is straightforward — take some of the edge off beef prices before the November midterm elections, when grocery costs remain one of the most closely watched indicators of how voters feel about the economy.
segments.tr: Mục tiêu đã nêu rõ là đơn giản — giảm bớt giá thịt bò trước cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ tháng 11, khi chi phí tạp hóa vẫn là một trong những chỉ số được theo dõi chặt chẽ nhất về cảm nhận của cử tri về nền kinh tế.

segments.src: Unlike a permanent policy shift, this kind of short-window tariff relief is designed to be reversible.
segments.tr: Không giống như sự thay đổi chính sách vĩnh viễn, giảm thuế cửa sổ ngắn hạn này được thiết kế để có thể hoàn nguyên.

segments.src: It allows more imported ground beef to enter the country at a lower duty rate for a defined period, with the expectation that officials will reassess once the window closes.
segments.tr: Nó cho phép nhiều thịt bò xay nhập khẩu hơn vào đất nước với mức thuế thấp hơn trong một khoảng thời gian xác định, với kỳ vọng rằng các quan chức sẽ đánh giá lại khi cửa sổ đóng.

segments.src: Administration officials have framed the move as a pragmatic, consumer-focused step rather than a broader retreat from the tariff strategy applied to other goods.
segments.tr: Các quan chức chính quyền đã trình bày bước đi này như một bước đi thực dụng, tập trung vào người tiêu dùng chứ không phải một sự rút lui rộng hơn khỏi chiến lược thuế áp dụng cho các hàng hóa khác.

segments.src: ## Why Beef Got Expensive in the First Place
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Thịt Bò Lại Đắt Tiền Từ Lúc Đầu

segments.src: The run-up in beef prices did not start with tariffs — it started on the range.
segments.tr: Sự tăng giá thịt bò không bắt đầu từ thuế — nó bắt đầu từ nông trại.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Cơ đàn gia súc U.S.

segments.src: cattle herd has been shrinking for years, a trend accelerated by prolonged drought conditions across major ranching states that made it more expensive to keep herds fed and watered.
segments.tr: đã thu nhỏ trong nhiều năm, một xu hướng tăng tốc bởi các điều kiện hạn hán kéo dài trên các bang chăn nuôi chính khiến việc nuôi đàn gia súc tốn kém hơn.

segments.src: Ranchers responded rationally by sending more cattle to slaughter and holding back fewer breeding animals, which cut supply in the short term but set up an even tighter herd for the years ahead.
segments.tr: Những người chăn nuôi đã phản ứng hợp lý bằng cách gửi nhiều gia súc hơn đến lò mổ và giữ lại ít động vật sinh sản hơn, điều này cắt giảm nguồn cung trong ngắn hạn nhưng tạo ra một đàn gia súc chặt chẽ hơn cho những năm tới.

segments.src: That dynamic left the U.S.
segments.tr: Động lực đó để lại U.S.

segments.src: beef supply chain unusually reliant on imports to meet domestic demand, particularly for the lean beef typically blended into ground beef products.
segments.tr: chuỗi cung ứng thịt bò phụ thuộc bất thường vào nhập khẩu để đáp ứng nhu cầu trong nước, đặc biệt là đối với thịt bò nạc thường được pha trộn thành sản phẩm thịt bò xay.

segments.src: When tariffs on imported beef rose earlier in the broader trade policy push, that additional cost fed directly into retail prices at a moment when herd numbers were already near multi-decade lows.
segments.tr: Khi thuế đối với thịt bò nhập khẩu tăng lên trước đó trong nỗ lực chính sách thương mại rộng lớn hơn, chi phí bổ sung đó được chuyển trực tiếp vào giá bán lẻ vào thời điểm mà số lượng đàn gia súc đã gần ở mức thấp nhất trong nhiều thập kỷ.

segments.src: ## The Case for the Break
segments.tr: ## Lý Do Ủng Hộ Khoảng Giảm Thuế

segments.src: Supporters of the temporary tariff reduction argue it is a targeted, limited-duration fix aimed at a specific product category rather than a wholesale change in trade policy.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ giảm thuế tạm thời cho rằng đó là một giải pháp hẹp hướng tới mục tiêu, có thời hạn hạn chế nhắm vào một danh mục sản phẩm cụ thể chứ không phải là thay đổi bán buôn trong chính sách thương mại.

segments.src: Ground beef is a kitchen-table staple, and price relief there can have an outsized effect on how households perceive overall inflation, even if it does not move the needle much on headline economic statistics.
segments.tr: Thịt bò xay là một thực phẩm thiết yếu tại bàn bếp, và giảm giá ở đó có thể có tác động vượt trội đến cách hộ gia đình nhận thức lạm phát tổng thể, ngay cả khi nó không ảnh hưởng nhiều đến các số liệu kinh tế chính.

segments.src: With the midterms approaching, cost-of-living concerns — especially at the grocery store — have remained a top issue for voters across the political spectrum, and officials have signaled they want tangible, visible relief before Election Day.
segments.tr: Với cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ sắp tới, mối lo ngại về chi phí sinh hoạt — đặc biệt là tại cửa hàng tạp hóa — vẫn là một vấn đề hàng đầu đối với cử tri trên toàn bộ phổ chính trị, và các quan chức đã báo hiệu họ muốn giảm nhẹ hữu hình, rõ rệt trước Ngày Bầu Cử.

segments.src: ## Why Ranching-State Republicans Are Uneasy
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Những Đảng Viên Cộng Hòa Từ Các Bang Chăn Nuôi Lại Lo Lắng

segments.src: Not everyone in the president's own party is on board.
segments.tr: Không phải ai trong đảng của tổng thống cũng đồng ý.

segments.src: Lawmakers from cattle-heavy states have spent recent years pushing policies meant to help ranchers rebuild the domestic herd — from disaster assistance tied to drought losses to trade measures intended to support demand for U.S.-raised beef.
segments.tr: Các nhà lập pháp từ các bang có nhiều gia súc đã dành những năm gần đây để thúc đẩy các chính sách nhằm giúp những người chăn nuôi tái xây dựng đàn gia súc trong nước — từ hỗ trợ thảm họa liên quan đến tổn thất hạn hán đến các biện pháp thương mại nhằm hỗ trợ nhu cầu đối với thịt bò được nuôi dưỡng ở U.S.

segments.src: Their concern with a tariff break, even a temporary one, is that it sends a mixed signal at a delicate moment: just as herd rebuilding becomes more attractive because prices are finally high enough to justify expansion, cheaper imports could blunt the price incentive that ranchers need to hold back heifers and grow their herds again.
segments.tr: Mối quan tâm của họ với khoảng giảm thuế, ngay cả một khoảng tạm thời, là nó gửi một tín hiệu hỗn hợp tại một thời điểm nhạy cảm: chính khi tái xây dựng đàn gia súc trở nên hấp dẫn hơn vì giá cuối cùng đã đủ cao để chứng minh sự mở rộng, nhập khẩu rẻ hơn có thể làm giảm động lực giá mà những người chăn nuôi cần để giữ lại những con bò cái trẻ và phát triển đàn gia súc của họ một lần nữa.

segments.src: That tension reflects a broader, familiar trade-off in agricultural trade policy: measures that help consumers in the short term can work against producers trying to make long-term investment decisions, and cattle ranching in particular involves multi-year breeding cycles that don't respond well to short bursts of price volatility.
segments.tr: Căng thẳng đó phản ánh một sự đánh đổi rộng hơn, quen thuộc trong chính sách thương mại nông nghiệp: các biện pháp giúp người tiêu dùng trong ngắn hạn có thể hoạt động chống lại những nhà sản xuất cố gắng đưa ra các quyết định đầu tư dài hạn, và chăn nuôi gia súc đặc biệt liên quan đến các chu kỳ sinh sản đa năm không phản ứng tốt với những bộc phát giá ngắn hạn.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Next
segments.tr: ## Điều Cần Theo Dõi Tiếp Theo

segments.src: A few things will determine whether this ends up as a minor, forgettable adjustment or a more consequential shift:
segments.tr: Một vài điều sẽ xác định liệu điều này có kết thúc như một sự điều chỉnh nhỏ, dễ quên hay một sự thay đổi có hậu quả hơn:

segments.src: - **Where the imported beef comes from.** The countries granted expanded access matter both for supply chain logistics and for how the move fits into the administration's broader trade posture with those trading partners.
segments.tr: - **Thịt bò nhập khẩu đến từ đâu.** Các quốc gia được cấp quyền truy cập mở rộng có vấn đề cả về logistik chuỗi cung ứng và cách bước đi này phù hợp với tư thế thương mại rộng hơn của chính quyền với những đối tác thương mại đó.

segments.src: - **What happens at the 90-day mark.** Whether the tariff break is allowed to expire, extended, or made permanent will signal how the administration is weighing consumer prices against domestic ranching interests going forward.
segments.tr: - **Điều gì xảy ra tại mốc 90 ngày.** Liệu khoảng giảm thuế có được phép hết hạn, kéo dài, hoặc được làm vĩnh viễn sẽ báo hiệu cách chính quyền cân bằng giá tiêu dùng so với lợi ích chăn nuôi trong nước tiến tới.

segments.src: - **Herd rebuilding trends.** Government data on cattle inventories, released periodically by the U.S. Department of Agriculture, will show whether ranchers are still moving toward herd expansion despite the added import competition.
segments.tr: - **Xu hướng tái xây dựng đàn gia súc.** Dữ liệu chính phủ về hàng tồn kho gia súc, được phát hành định kỳ bởi Bộ Nông nghiệp U.S., sẽ cho thấy liệu những người chăn nuôi có vẫn đang hướng tới sự mở rộng đàn gia súc bất chấp cạnh tranh nhập khẩu tăng thêm.

segments.src: - **Retail price pass-through.** Tariff relief does not automatically translate into lower shelf prices; how much of the savings reaches consumers versus processors and retailers will shape the political payoff of the move.
segments.tr: - **Chuyển tải giá bán lẻ.** Giảm thuế không tự động dịch thành giá kệ thấp hơn; bao nhiêu tiền tiết kiệm đến được người tiêu dùng so với các nhà xử lý và nhà bán lẻ sẽ định hình lợi ích chính trị của bước đi.

segments.src: For now, the policy sits in a familiar spot for election-year economics: a short-term fix aimed at an immediate, visible cost pressure, layered on top of a longer-running structural challenge in the cattle industry that a 90-day tariff window is unlikely to resolve on its own.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, chính sách nằm ở một vị trí quen thuộc đối với kinh tế năm bầu cử: một giải pháp ngắn hạn nhằm vào áp lực chi phí tức thì, rõ rệt, được xếp chồng lên thách thức cấu trúc lâu dài hơn trong ngành gia súc mà một cửa sổ thuế 90 ngày không có khả năng giải quyết một mình.
